items.title: Github Migrates Copilot Runtime to Rust with AI-Assisted Rewrite
items.blurb: GitHub migrated more than 800,000 lines of Copilot runtime code from TypeScript and Node.js to Rust in about 14.5 weeks using AI-assisted development.

items.title: CircleCI Makes Machine Runner Orchestrator Generally Available
items.blurb: CircleCI has made its Machine Runner Orchestrator 1.0.0 generally available, providing automated scaling of self-hosted machine runner virtual machines according to CI workload demand. By Craig Risi

items.title: Olson and Söderqvist Discuss Valkey’s Evolution and Future Past Caching Use Cases at OSS EU
items.blurb: Valkey is a growing project, launched as a fork of Redis over two years ago, supported by twelve maintainers and nine committee members from various companies.

items.title: Bridging technical depth and usability: The story behind Radar’s redesign
items.blurb: We redesigned Cloudflare Radar to make real-time global traffic and outage data accessible to a wider audience — including journalists, less technical researchers, and everyday users.

items.title: Cloudflare K2 Builds Event Streams on R2 Object Storage, at a Second of Produce Latency
items.blurb: Cloudflare has launched K2 in public beta, a serverless event streaming service implementing a durable log on R2 object storage.

items.title: How one bug bounty researcher chooses the features they investigate
items.blurb: As we kick off Cybersecurity Awareness Month, the GitHub Bug Bounty team spotlights @vaib25vicky, exploring their methodology, techniques, and experiences hacking on GitHub.
